cim: AI 'kill switch' no solution to growing cybersecurity risks: Former OpenAI board member
cim_eredeti: AI 'kill switch' no solution to growing cybersecurity risks: Former OpenAI board member
szoveg_eredeti:
A former OpenAI board member cautioned Sunday that an emergency shutdown mechanism for artificial intelligence would provide limited protection against rising cybersecurity risks, as US lawmakers seek to introduce federal regulations for the rapidly developing technology.

Helen Toner, executive director of Georgetown University's Center for Security and Emerging Technology, told Fox News on Sunday that a single "kill switch" would not be sufficient to address the challenges posed by AI.

"There's not gonna be a single kill switch that can fix all our problems, unfortunately," Toner warned

Toner said emergency shutdown systems could mitigate certain risks but emphasized that autonomous AI systems and those operating outside US jurisdiction would be harder to regulate.

She also questioned whether technology companies were fully disclosing the causes of recent widespread outages, suggesting that some disruptions could stem from urgent efforts to address security flaws before cybercriminals exploit them.

Addressing reported discussions between US President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping on AI safety, Toner said Washington and Beijing share an interest in avoiding potentially disastrous incidents involving the technology, despite their mutual distrust.
